title: 第11章 为江山社稷，陛下三思！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 这时，唐敬正和身侧的武将吵得脸红耳赤，忽然感觉身上有冷芒，抬头就看到炎文帝在看他。唐敬先是吓了一跳，然后立即就激动了。陛下看我干什么？是在给我鼓励啊！我可是主和派的代表，陛下看我了，那就是他选择了主和。“陛下，臣以为还是和谈为好。”唐敬当即站了出来，正义凛然道：“如今我大炎尚在休养生息，而北狄兵强马壮，若和北狄开战，我大炎胜算绝对超不过一成。”“一旦战火燃烧，我大炎战败，届时再想和谈，恐怕北狄也不愿意。”“为我大炎江山社稷，臣恳请陛下三思。”炎文帝眉心猛地一跳。不是，老东西你是不是误会了什么？朕看你，是因为你虐待一个少年天才，朕想抽你。你还来劲了，以为朕是鼓励你呢？朕鼓励你个大头鬼！“爱卿，你……”炎文帝刚开口，结果主和派的一群官员立即站了出来，打断了他。“陛下，唐侍郎所言甚是，我大炎如今尚未与北狄一决雌雄之资本。”“陛下三思，一旦开战，恐靖康耻会重演，届时我等有何脸面去面对先祖？”“陛下，臣附议……”“……”炎文帝看着这一幕，脸色一点点阴沉下来。朕是脾气太好了，所以你们都觉得朕没脾气了是吧？“狗屁！放特妈的狗屁！”一道怒喝声宛若惊雷传遍全场。一个年过花甲白发苍苍的老者走出，手指着唐敬等大臣怒斥：“特妈的，仗还没打呢，你们就特妈想着投降了？”“还和谈？这特妈叫和谈吗？这叫卖国！”“这一次，你们又想出多少银子？又想牺牲掉多少万大炎女人？特妈的不是你们的妻女你们不知道心疼是吧？”老将军狄苍看向炎文帝，道：“陛下，和平是打出来的，从来就不是用钱买的。”“臣请挂帅，北狄若真敢战，臣愿和北狄决一死战。”“北狄铁骑想南下，先踏过我狄苍这把老骨头！”狄苍虽老，却声若洪钟，震动全场。当即，很多武将也站了出来，声援狄苍。“陛下，臣愿跟随老将军死战北狄！”“陛下，臣愿为老将军先锋，率我大炎儿郎诛贼寇！”“……”见到一群武将来劲了，主和的文臣当时就不干了。“莽夫，和北狄打，你们打得嬴吗？”“粗鄙武夫，没有一点大局观，我羞于尔等为伍。”“特妈的，你说谁粗鄙呢？”“……”整个大殿瞬间喧嚣起来，吵得就像菜市场。很多文臣呸呸乱吐口水，气得一群武将撸着袖子，忍不住要将这群软骨头按在地上暴捶一顿。又来……炎文帝看着乱糟糟的大殿，抬手拍了拍额头。国家大事呢，你们能不能给朕认真点？炎文帝看了一眼身侧的陈貂寺，陈貂寺大喝一声：“肃静！”整个大殿这才渐渐安静下来。群臣齐齐抬头看向炎文帝。炎文帝站了起来，目光睥睨全场：“吵完了？那到朕了。”“是战是和，不能只听你们的，也得听听民间的声音。”“刚好，朕昨日出了一趟宫，问了一个小……少年这个问题。”“这就是他的答案，你们想知道吗？”炎文帝从袖中取出了誊抄了《满江红》的纸张，扬了扬。群臣当时就震惊了，原来这就是陛下下定决心的原因！只是什么样的少年，给的什么样的答案，能影响到这位心思深沉的陛下？“算了，陈貂寺，向他们宣布答案吧！”炎文帝懒得废话，将手中的纸张递给身侧的老太监。老太监将折叠的纸张拆开，道：“答案是一首词，名为《满江红·精忠报国》。”“怒发冲冠，凭栏处、潇潇雨歇。抬望眼，仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切！”“靖康耻，犹未雪。臣子恨，何时灭！驾长车，踏破贺兰山缺。壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。待从头、收拾旧山河，朝天阙。”老太监虽然声音细细，但武艺高强，一首《满江红》，出自他口中却气势磅礴。整个大殿瞬间陷入了死一般的寂静。所有大臣都呆住了。一首词，短短百余字，却写尽了作词者抗击北狄，收复山河，统一国家的强烈爱国精神！诗词慷慨激昂，自带一股浩然正气，不得不说，这是几百上千年来反对侵略战争的传世名篇！这出自一个少年之手？这怎么可能出自一个少年之手？若没有饱受战争之苦，经历战争之难，是难以写出这种旷世之作的。难怪能让陛下下定决心，这诗词的震撼力实在太大了！炎文帝看着落针可闻的大殿，嘴角微微勾起。这就对了嘛，朕就想看到你们这震惊的样子。“陛下，陛下万岁，陛下万岁啊！”老将军狄苍最先回过神，扑通一声就跪在地上，顿足捶胸老泪纵横：“陛下，这首词写的就是老臣啊！”“老臣不为陛下收拾旧山河，老臣死不瞑目啊！”“不知写这首词的少年是谁，老臣愿意与他结为异姓兄弟。”听到老将军的话，一群武将顿时就炸了。“陛下，臣也愿意与这位小兄弟结为异姓兄弟。”“哈哈，别说异姓兄弟，就是义父老子都认了！”“妈的，谁说我们武将是粗鄙武夫的，站出来盘盘道。”“……”一群武将也都激动了，炎文帝拿出这首诗的意思也就很明显了。打！说道理他们说不过这群文官，原本以为没机会了，没想到因为一首词，顿时柳暗花明又一村，那少年简直就是他们的救命恩人。别说认兄弟，认义父都行！而一群文官，看着这一幕脸都绿了。这首词是站在军人的角度写的，他们很想说这是一首拍马屁的词……可问题是不拍马屁的词，他们写不出来啊！究竟是谁？竟然敢和他们作对？！特别是唐敬，这时候目瞪口呆地看着炎文帝。陛下，你看我不是给我鼓励吗？不是给我鼓励你看我干啥？害我误会了啊！
content_en: At this time, Tang Jing was quarreling with the military commander beside him and his face was red. Suddenly he felt a cold light on his body. He looked up and saw Emperor Yanwen looking at him.Tang Jing was startled at first, and then immediately became excited.What is your Majesty looking at me for?You are encouraging me!I am the representative of the Peace Party. When Your Majesty sees me, it means he has chosen the Peace Party."Your Majesty, I think it would be better to negotiate peace." Tang Jing immediately stood up and said righteously: "Now I, Dayan, are still recuperating, and Beidi has strong soldiers and horses. If there is a war with Beidi, my chance of winning is absolutely beyond our reach.Only 10%." "Once the war breaks out and we, Dayan, are defeated, I am afraid Beidi will not be willing to negotiate for peace." "For the sake of my country, Great Yan, I beg your Majesty to think twice." Emperor Yanwen's eyebrows jumped sharply.No, old man, did you misunderstand something?I look at you because you abused a young genius, and I want to whip you.You are still in high spirits, do you think I am encouraging you?I encourage you, you big-headed ghost!"Ai Qing, you..." Emperor Yan Wen just started to speak, but a group of officials from the Lord He faction immediately stood up and interrupted him."Your Majesty, what the Minister of the Tang Dynasty said is true. I, Dayan, have not yet competed with Beidi for capital." "Your Majesty, think twice. Once the war starts, the humiliation of Jingkang will happen again. How will we have the face to face our ancestors?" "Your Majesty, I second the proposal..." "..." Emperor Yan Wen looked at this scene, and his face became gloomy.I have such a good temper, so you all think I have lost my temper, right?"Bullshit! What the fuck!" An angry shout echoed throughout the audience like thunder.A gray-haired old man who was over sixty years old walked out, pointed at Tang Jing and other ministers and angrily shouted: "Damn it, the war hasn't even started yet, and you are thinking of surrendering?" "You still want to have peace talks? Is this called peace talks? This is called traitorous!" "How much money do you want this time? How many thousands of Dayan women do you want to sacrifice? Damn it, you are not your wife and daughter.You don't know how to feel, right?" The old general Di Cang looked at Emperor Yan Wen and said, "Your Majesty, peace is fought for, never bought with money." "Please take charge, if Beidi really dares to fight, I am willing to fight to the death with Beidi." "If the Beidi cavalry wants to go south, they must first step on my old bones!" Although Di Cang is old, his voice is like a bell, which shakes the whole audience.Immediately, many generals also stood up to support Di Cang."Your Majesty, I am willing to follow the old general and fight to the death in Beidi!" "Your Majesty, I am willing to be the vanguard for the old general and lead my great Yan'erlang to kill the bandits!" "..." Seeing the enthusiasm of a group of military generals, the civil servants who advocated peace stopped at that time."Reckless man, will you win in a fight with Beidi?" "A vulgar warrior with no sense of the overall situation. I'm ashamed to be in the same company as you." "Damn it, who are you calling vulgar?" "..." The whole hall instantly became noisy, like a vegetable market.Many civil servants spat indiscriminately, and a group of generals were so angry that they rolled up their sleeves and couldn't help but push these weaklings to the ground and beat them violently.Here we go again... Emperor Yanwen looked at the messy hall and raised his hand to pat his forehead.What about national affairs? Can you take it seriously?Emperor Yanwen glanced at Chen Diao Si beside him, and Chen Diao Si shouted: "Quiet!" Then the whole hall gradually became quiet.All the ministers raised their heads and looked at Emperor Yanwen.Emperor Yanwen stood up and looked at the audience: "Are you done with the quarrel? That's my turn." "Whether it's war or peace, I can't just listen to you, but also listen to the voices of the people." "It just so happened that I went out to the palace yesterday and asked a young... boy this question." "This is his answer, do you want to know?" Emperor Yanwen took out the paper with "Man Jiang Hong" copied from his sleeve and waved it.The ministers were shocked at that time. It turned out that this was the reason why His Majesty made up his mind!But what kind of boy and what kind of answer can he give that can affect this deep-thinking majesty?"Forget it, Chen Diao Si, announce the answer to them!" Emperor Yanwen was too lazy to talk nonsense and handed the paper in his hand to the old eunuch beside him.The old eunuch opened the folded paper and said: "The answer is a poem called "The River is Red: Serving the Country with Loyalty." "Fuming with anger, I leaned on the railing, and the rain stopped. I looked up, roared to the sky, and my heart was strong. Thirty years of fame and fame, eight thousand miles of clouds and moon. Don't wait, the young man's head will turn white, and he will be filled with sorrow!"The shame of Jingkang is still there. When will the hatred of the ministers be destroyed? I will drive a long chariot to break through the gap in Helan Mountain. I will laugh and drink the blood of the Huns. I will clean up the old mountains and rivers and face the sky."Although the old eunuch has a thin voice, his martial arts are very powerful.The song "Man Jiang Hong" comes from him with great force.The entire hall instantly fell into deathly silence.All the ministers were stunned.One poem, just over a hundred words long, fully describes the author's strong patriotic spirit of fighting against Beidi, regaining mountains and rivers, and reunifying the country!The poem is impassioned and has a sense of righteousness. It must be said that this is a famous poem handed down from generation to generation to oppose wars of aggression for hundreds or thousands of years!Was this written by a young man?How could this be written by a young man?If one had not suffered from the pain of war and experienced the difficulties of war, it would be difficult to write such a masterpiece.No wonder it can make His Majesty make up his mind, this poem is so shocking!Emperor Yanwen looked at the main hall where the needle could be heard, and the corners of his mouth were slightly raised.That's right, I just want to see your shocked look."Your Majesty, long live your Majesty, long live your Majesty!" The old general Di Cang was the first to come to his senses, and with a plop he knelt on the ground, stamping his feet and beating his chest with tears streaming down his face: "Your Majesty, this poem is about the old minister!" "Old General!If I don't clean up the old mountains and rivers for Your Majesty, I will die in peace!" "I don't know who the young man is who wrote this poem.I am willing to become brothers with different surnames." Hearing the words of the old general, a group of generals exploded."Your Majesty, I am also willing to become a brother of a different surname with this little brother." "Haha, let alone a brother with a different surname, even the adoptive father and I recognize him!" "Damn it, who said that our military generals are vulgar warriors? Stand up and ask." "..." A group of military generals were also excited, and the meaning of Emperor Yanwen's poem was obvious.beat!They couldn't reason with this group of civil servants. They originally thought they had no chance, but they didn't expect that because of a poem, a whole village suddenly became brighter and brighter, and that young man was their savior.Not to mention recognizing him as a brother, he can even recognize him as a foster father!And a group of civil servants turned green when they saw this scene.This poem was written from the perspective of soldiers. They really wanted to say that it was a flattering poem... But the problem was that they couldn't write a word that wasn't flattering!Who is it?How dare you go against them?
title_en: Chapter 11 For the sake of the country and the country, Your Majesty, please think twice!
